content.text: Admission horizontal-nav Breadcrumb Home Admission Why Bullis? Bullis Helps Every Student Reach Their Fullest Potential Where Curiosity, Joy, and Confidence Come Together Bullis offers a learning experience where curiosity meets confidence and joy in learning is at the heart of every day. The energy and connection of our campus set us apart, creating a supportive, joyful environment that inspires students to engage deeply, think critically, and grow with confidence in a challenging academic program. Guided by dedicated, caring faculty, students are known, supported, and encouraged to thrive—academically, socially, and emotionally—while offering exceptional facilities—from innovative makerspaces to dynamic athletic and arts programs. At Bullis, students don’t just learn—they thrive, develop resilience, and discover what excites them about the world. Challenge. Community. What an amazing foundation to propel my academic life. I am so grateful to the teachers, faculty, coaches, and staff at Bullis for giving me a strong start. I have friends for life from this school and will always draw back to Bullis' lessons on how to be a lifelong learner and a good person! Aryemis Brown '17, First Lieutenant, United States Space Force and Rhodes Scholar Self-Guided Tour of Bullis
